sort_includes: sort the #include lines of a C++ or C source file according to LLVM coding conventions
refactor_sort_includes: refactor a .cpp or .h file to sort its #include directives into API, local, subproject, llvm, and system groups
run_sort_includes_cli: run the sort_includes CLI tool on multiple source files to automatically organize their include blocks
review_sort_includes: review the sort_includes function that categorizes and sorts #include directives by header type
summarize_sort_includes: summarize how the sort_includes script reorders #include lines into five sorted groups
